notes: A Games page finds every game on your PC (Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Xbox) and mods it the safe way: removing mods puts every original file back.
One-click Thunderstore mods for around 300 games, GameBanana for Half-Life 2 and Portal, Nexus Mods from your Downloads, or any .zip, .7z or .rar.
GTA V mods run in Story Mode only and leave before GTA Online; Elden Ring gets Seamless Co-op with a shared password; Spider-Man goes through Overstrike.
Games whose anti-cheat bans for changed files, like PUBG, are shown and never touched.
